mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.item_id, c.qty FROM `${cartTable}` c WHERE c.username=#{username} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT id, item_id, qty FROM `${cartTable}` WHERE username=#{username} AND item_id=#{itemId}
SELECT * FROM `${lineTable}` WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM `${orderTable}` WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND status IN ('pending','confirmed','shipped')
SELECT id FROM `${orderTable}` WHERE status='pending' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${orderTable}` GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${orderTable}` WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `${orderTable}` WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 5 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
SELECT l.title AS name, SUM(l.qty) AS value FROM `${lineTable}` l INNER JOIN `${orderTable}` o ON o.id=l.order_id AND o.status='completed' GROUP BY l.title ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 8
